what: Word-rivals audit of the remakes decision test: word-only measures a hostile referee would say were left out of the 39 word columns, each put in the units' place and each added to the word columns. Made by results/v2/second/audit/word_rivals.py. Every number unrounded. exploratory: made after the registered result was seen.
exploratory: exploratory: made after the registered result was seen

how_to_read.T: the statistic of the registered test: the sum over families of the family sums of the entries' contributions
how_to_read.Z: T divided by the root of the sum of the squared family sums
how_to_read.p: the registered one-sided sign-flip p of the family sums (100,000 flips, seed 20261108); known to be too small on this list (PLAN Section 16, entry 3)
how_to_read.noise_p_registered_draws: the share of the 2,000 registered pure-noise draws (remakes_null_size.json, the 39 columns) whose Z is at or above this Z, this one counted; exact for anything put in the units' place with the word columns unchanged; 'indicative' where columns were added
how_to_read.noise_p_own_draws: the same share among 300 noise draws put through the analysis's own word model (cells under 1e-08 left out)
how_to_read.gain: the held-out log-likelihood of the true sources with the measure's column added to the word model, minus without it (remake_test.RemakeTest.gain)
how_to_read.effective_pairs_left_open: the sum over entries of one minus the held-out word probability of the true source
how_to_read.condition_5: the stand-in panel is not rebuilt; in the second round the 74 registered stand-ins are read from the saved panel and put in the units' place under the word models of A-T1 and A-ALL, so conditions 2 and 5 of the plan are re-evaluated for those two models and for no other

notes: The list of analyses in the script's docstring, the word classes and every definition were written before any of them was run.

Before the real run the code was tried on every sixth entry (37 entries) with random numbers in the units' place and every rival's rows shuffled over the entries (AUDIT_DRY=1); that trial showed no result. The words-only description (D) of each rival was seen on those 37 entries before the real run.

The second round (X0, X2a, X2b) was added after part of the first round had been seen; its definition, as written at that moment, is in the script's docstring. The first round was not run again: its blocks were read back from the folder AUDIT_PARTS, and X2a and X2b check that they rebuild the same word models (they must give the units the Z of A-T1 and of A-ALL).

After the trial and before the real run, the dynamic programme of O1 and O2, the position correlation of O3 and the name tokens were checked against direct computations on words alone; in that check the values of O1, O2 and O3 for the documented sources of six entries were seen. No definition was changed after it.
With 300 noise draws a noise_p_own_draws cannot be below 1/301 = 0.0033; with the 2,000 registered draws the floor is 0.0005.

S1's six columns are chosen by their weights in the model fitted on all entries, so the choice (not the weights of the products) has seen every family's label; S2's score for a family comes from a model that never saw that family.
Rivals in the units' place are 16 word-only measures chosen by one reviewer; on this list pure noise has p below 0.05 in 10.9% of draws.

definitions.names_tfidf: N1: TF-IDF cosine over the lower-cased name tokens (a token capitalised inside a sentence, or first in its sentence and of a name type); no stop list
definitions.names_containment: N1b: share of the candidate's distinct name-token types (in 2 films or more, at most half of the films read) that the remake has among its name tokens
definitions.no_names_tfidf: N2: TF-IDF cosine over the lower-cased ordinary (not name) tokens, stop words dropped
definitions.rare_df2to5_tfidf: R1: TF-IDF cosine over the words (stop words dropped) that are in at least 2 and at most 5 of the films read
definitions.rare_df2to20_tfidf: R2: TF-IDF cosine over the words (stop words dropped) that are in at least 2 and at most 20 of the films read
definitions.order_alignment: O1: best monotone alignment of the two sentence sequences (sum of sentence TF-IDF cosines over an order-keeping matching, no gap cost) / sqrt(sentences of r * sentences of c)
definitions.order_minus_reversed: O2: O1 minus the same score with the candidate's sentences in reverse order
definitions.order_word_positions: O3: atanh(Pearson correlation of the first positions of the shared words in the two texts) * sqrt(shared words - 3); words in 2 films to 5% of the films read; 0 under 4 shared words
definitions.stems_no_names_tfidf: T1: TF-IDF cosine over the stems (remake_test._stem) of the ordinary tokens, stop words dropped
definitions.word_classes: T2: cosine of the two films' 16 word-class rates (log(1 + 1000 * class tokens / tokens), each class standardised over the films read); the classes are CLASSES in the script
definitions.word_class_arc: T2b: the same in three consecutive parts of each film: cosine of 48 standardised values
definitions.ppmi_svd_centroid: T3: cosine of film vectors made of count-based word vectors (sentence co-occurrence in the films read, positive PMI, SVD to 200 dimensions), words weighted by (1 + log count) * idf; no name type, no stop word
definitions.gbm_score: S2: held-out log odds of a gradient-boosted classifier of 'this cell is the source' on the registered 39 columns, fitted leaving families out in 10 folds
definitions.embedding_minus_top3_pcs: E1: cosine of the mean sentence embeddings after centring on the films read and removing the 3 leading principal components
definitions.embedding_minus_top10_pcs: E2: the same with the 10 leading principal components removed
definitions.embedding_centred_within_industry: E3: cosine of the mean sentence embeddings after subtracting the mean vector of the films read of the film's industry
definitions.embedding_cosine: E0: the registered comparator: cosine of the mean sentence embeddings
